name: mujoco
description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
one_liner: A free, highly accurate physics simulator that lets you test how a robot or mechanical system will move and behave before building the real thing.
buyer: A hardware-light robotics startup's engineer who needs to train and test robot control software before risking an expensive physical prototype.
business_use_cases: A robotics startup trains a robot arm's grasping behavior entirely in MuJoCo simulation, cutting months off the time before the physical prototype needs to work.
A sports-science company builds a biomechanics analysis tool on top of MuJoCo to model and sell injury-risk assessments to pro and amateur athletic teams.
An engineering bootcamp builds an interactive physics sandbox for teaching robotics and mechanics without needing a lab full of real robots.

money_ideas.idea: Custom simulation-environment consulting for robotics teams
Hosted cloud simulation-as-a-service for small robotics teams without local compute

steal_this: Build and sell a ready-made MuJoCo simulation environment for one common robot task (pick-and-place, balancing) that small robotics teams can plug their own hardware specs into.
